req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The view_cookies handler reads request.cookies, filters ENV_COOKIES when hide_env=True and show_env not in args, then returns jsonify(cookies=cookies). Tests must cover: (1) positive - cookies present are echoed exactly; (2) negative - no cookies yields empty dict; (3) boundary - single cookie (BVA at count=1); (4) multiple cookies (EP); (5) show_env query param behaviour (DT); (6) wrong HTTP method (NEG). Assertions use exact values to kill constant, operator, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing one name=value pair
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data == {'cookies': {'session': 'abc123'}}
    assert data['cookies']['session'] == 'abc123'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value()

actions: Send GET /cookies with exactly one cookie named 'x' with value 'y'

def test_get_cookies_boundary_exactly_one_cookie():

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_multiple_cookies_returns_all
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing three cookies
expected: All three cookies present with exact values
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_get_cookies_with_multiple_cookies_returns_all():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'a=1; b=2; c=3'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    cookies = data['cookies']
    assert len(cookies) == 3
    assert cookies['a'] == '1'
    assert cookies['b'] == '2'
    assert cookies['c'] == '3'

test_get_cookies_with_multiple_cookies_returns_all()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_top_level_key_is_exactly_cookies
actions: Inspect JSON keys at top level
expected: Top-level JSON has exactly one key: 'cookies'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_get_cookies_top_level_key_is_exactly_cookies():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'foo=bar'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert list(data.keys()) == ['cookies']
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'headers' not in data
    assert 'args' not in data
    assert data['cookies']['foo'] == 'bar'

test_get_cookies_top_level_key_is_exactly_cookies()

    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'first=one; second=two'})

tests.name: test_get_cookies_exact_cookie_name_not_mutated
actions: Send GET /cookies with cookie named 'user_id' value '42'
expected: Key is exactly 'user_id', value is exactly '42'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_get_cookies_exact_cookie_name_not_mutated():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'user_id=42'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'user_id' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['user_id'] == '42'
    assert 'userid' not in data['cookies']
    assert 'user-id' not in data['cookies']

test_get_cookies_exact_cookie_name_not_mutated()
